shortDefinition: The large dataset of examples used to teach an AI model its initial capabilities.
fullDefinition: Training data is the dataset used to train an AI model. For LLMs, this is typically hundreds of billions of tokens of text from the internet, books, code repositories, and other sources. The quality, breadth, and recency of training data directly affects model capabilities and biases. Models cannot answer questions based on information not in their training data (without tools that extend access).
